evidence.quote: Flow cytometry analysis was done on either heparinized whole blood or cryopreserved PBMCs.

evidence.section: Zostavax®-specific IFN-γ, IL-4 and IL-21 ELISPOT
evidence.quote: Cryopreserved cells (3–5×10 5 /well) were resuspended in RPMI 1640 + 10% human AB serum (Sigma Aldrich), penicillin, streptomycin, L-glutamine and 2-mercaptoethanol and added to each plate, stimulated with either media alone, 0.25 μg of VZV cell lysate (Meridian Life Sciences - Strain Ellen grade II detergent free) or VZV HLA-A2-restricted peptide pool (ILIEGIFFV (Ribonucleotide reductase subunit 2 ( Chiu et al., 2014 )), DLLYFVCLGV (ORF34; previously identified in Ahmed laboratory), ALWALPHAA (IE62 ( van der Heiden et al., 2009 )), SLPRSRTPI (IE62 (Frey et al., 2003)) and SAPLPSNRV (IE62 (Frey et al., 2003))).

evidence.section: Zostavax®-specific and total IgG B cell ELISPOT
evidence.quote: Freshly prepared PBMCs were resuspended in complete FBS media at 1×10 7 /ml and added to each well, followed by threefold dilution and then incubated overnight at 37°C.
Plasma samples were serially diluted in blocking buffer and incubated for 1.5 hr at room temperature.
Amplification was performed with a RotorGene (RG-3000) real-time PCR System or the Bio-Rad CFX96 real-time PCR system, depending on availability.

In order to increase the sensitivity to detect VZV DNA ORF63, and to verify the PCR products having the same DNA sequence of VZV ORF63, nested PCR analysis was carried out on 1/40 of the volume of PCR product that did not initially contain detectable VZV DNA.

The type of VZV DNA detected was identified on random positive samples by partial sequencing of amplicons to include codon 958 of ORF62, which distinguishes vaccine strain VZV (V-Oka) from wild type varicella (Gomi et al., 2002).
Luminex assays were performed with the Beadlyte Human 10-Plex Multi-Cytokine Detection System (Upstate).

evidence.section: In vitro stimulation of PBMCs with Zostavax®
evidence.quote: Cell-free culture supernatants collected were analyzed for cytokines and chemokines, including IL-6, TNF, CXCL8, CCL2, CXCL9 and CXCL10 using Cytokine Bead Array (CBA) kits (BD Biosciences, San Diego, US)
Samples, after quality control, were hybridized on Human U133 Plus 2.0 Arrays (Affymetrix).

Mass spectral data were collected with a 10-minute reversed phase gradient on a Thermo Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher, San Diego, CA) set to record from mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) 85 to 2000.
Metabolite confirmation was performed with tandem MS-MS experiments on Thermo QE HF, Orbitrap Fusion, or Finnigan LTQ FT Ultra mass spectrometers.
